title: Checkpoint: World 3
objectives: Apply everything learned in World 3 (comparison, IF/ELSE, nested decisions, logical operators, CASE, decision mistakes) together

hook.text: You have reached the end of World 3. Now it is time to test decision structures with mixed questions.

concept.heading: Checkpoint
concept.body: This lesson does not teach a new topic; it reinforces what you have learned. The questions below test comparison, IF/ELSE, nested decisions, logical operators, and decision mistakes in a mix.

exercises.question: What does this code write to the screen?
When grade ← 55, what does this code write to the screen?
When age ← 25 and isStudent ← FALSE, what does this code write to the screen?
exercises.hint: For AND, both conditions must be TRUE; isStudent is FALSE.

exercises.question: When grade ← 72, what does this code write to the screen?
When is the expression "A OR B" FALSE?
options: When both A and B are TRUE
When both A and B are FALSE

feedback.correct: Correct. OR gives FALSE only if both conditions are FALSE.
feedback.incorrect: An OR expression is FALSE only when BOTH A and B are FALSE.

exercises.question: What happens if a broad condition (e.g. ≥0) is written before a narrow condition (e.g. ≥18) in an IF chain?
options: The narrow condition can never be tested on its own: an unreachable branch

feedback.correct: Correct. The broad condition "catches" the narrow one, so the narrow condition can never be tested on its own.
feedback.incorrect: If a broad condition is written first, the narrow condition after it can never be evaluated on its own.

exercises.question: Put the steps of the algorithm that finds whether a number is even or odd in the correct order.
Complete the sentence.
exercises.template: A CASE structure is, behind the scenes, an IF chain that makes consecutive equality checks using the ___ variable.

summary: World 3 complete: comparison operators, IF/ELSE, nested decisions, logical operators, CASE, decision mistakes.
These skills will be used directly in the condition part of the loops you will learn in World 4.
You will see the topics you struggled with again in your review queue.
